input.summary: 3-axis milling on VMC 2 is most cost-effective for this angle bracket.
reasons: Hidden area 3-axis is 0%, confirming all features accessible with 3-axis machining
4 through holes at 6.58mm diameter align with standard 3-axis drilling operations
VMC 2 offers 5-day lead time versus 14-day requirement, providing schedule buffer
Unit price $41.40 is 14% lower than 5-axis alternative at $47.93
risks: Tight leg thickness tolerance of ±0.05mm requires careful setup and tool selection
